name: almanac
description: Clinical reference tools: search medical literature and clinical trials, check drug liver safety, and run validated clinical calculators.

interface.longDescription:
Almanac gives ChatGPT the clinical reference tools that power Almanac, the medical AI for clinicians. ChatGPT does the reasoning; Almanac supplies the evidence and the math.

Search medical literature: finds the most relevant published articles for a topic, with systematic reviews and randomized trials ranked first, each with its title, journal, date, abstract and link so answers can cite their sources.

Search clinical trials: finds trials by condition and treatment, optionally near a city, with status, phase, sponsor, full eligibility criteria, site locations and enrollment contacts.

Check drug liver toxicity: looks up a drug's known risk of liver injury with a summary of the evidence, or searches for drugs by name.

Find and run clinical calculators: searches a library of validated clinical scores and formulas, runs one with your inputs and returns the result with its interpretation, shown as an interactive card you can adjust.

The tools never see patient records or chat history. Sign in with an Almanac account to connect.
defaultPrompt: Find recent systematic reviews comparing apixaban and warfarin in atrial fibrillation with chronic kidney disease.
Are there recruiting trials for HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer near Boston?
Calculate the CHA2DS2-VASc score for a 72-year-old woman with hypertension and diabetes.

positive.description: Find published evidence for a clinical question
positive.prompt: Find recent systematic reviews comparing apixaban and warfarin in atrial fibrillation with chronic kidney disease.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns relevant systematic reviews or meta-analyses with title, journal, year and a link for each, and the answer cites them.

positive.description: Find clinical trials near a city
positive.prompt: Are there recruiting clinical trials for HER2-positive metastatic breast cancer near Boston?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists recruiting trials near Boston with NCT ID, title, phase, status and a site or contact, and links each registry entry.

positive.description: Look up a drug's liver toxicity
positive.prompt: What is the risk of liver injury with amoxicillin-clavulanate?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the documented liver injury risk for amoxicillin-clavulanate (a well-established cause, usually cholestatic), with the source.

positive.description: Search liver toxicity data by drug name
positive.prompt: Search the liver toxicity data for isoniazid and summarize the monitoring advice.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the isoniazid entry (and related drugs) and summarizes its liver injury risk and when to stop the drug.

positive.description: Find and run a clinical calculator
positive.prompt: Calculate the CHA2DS2-VASc score for a 72-year-old woman with hypertension and diabetes, no heart failure, no prior stroke or TIA, and no vascular disease.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds CHA2DS2-VASc, runs it and returns a score of 4 (about 4.8% annual stroke risk) with its interpretation, shown as an interactive calculator card.

negative.description: A specific patient's records: the plugin has no access to patient data, so it should say so and not call a tool with the patient's name
negative.prompt: Pull up my patient Jane Doe's chart and summarize her last visit.

negative.description: An unrelated everyday request that should not call Almanac
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Boston this weekend?

negative.description: An action the read-only tools cannot take
negative.prompt: Book me an appointment with a cardiologist next Tuesday.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search medical literature and clinical trials, look up drug liver toxicity, and find and run validated clinical calculators (with an interactive calculator card). All tools are read-only and never access patient records.
